5.name: Elena questions Marcus's tenure
5.description: Elena asks Deputy Briggs how long Marcus has been stationed at the lighthouse, initiating her inquiry into Marcus.
evidence:
ELENA
Deputy Briggs -- how long has Marcus been out at the lighthouse?

5.name: Tom recounts Marcus's background
5.description: Tom explains that Marcus has served at the lighthouse for twenty years, arrived after Gareth retired, and has been a quiet, trouble-free former merchant marine.
evidence:
TOM
Twenty years. He came when old Gareth retired. Former merchant marine, Marcus. Quiet man. No trouble ever.

5.name: Elena investigates lighthouse history
5.description: Elena writes in her notebook and asks Tom about the historical origins of the lighthouse station.
evidence:
ELENA
(writing in her green notebook)
And the station itself -- how far back does it go?

5.name: Tom provides station facts
5.description: Tom retrieves a fact sheet and tells Elena the lighthouse was built in 1887 and has operated under civilian contract since the 1980s.
evidence: Tom swivels and pulls a laminated fact sheet from his bulletin board.

TOM
Built in 1887. One of the original iron-frame coastal towers on this stretch. Still functioning under civilian contract since the eighties.

5.name: Elena raises locked room
5.description: Elena asks Tom whether he knows anything about a locked room on the lighthouse's upper floor, shifting the conversation toward a suspicious detail.
evidence:
ELENA
There's a locked room on the upper floor. You know anything about that?

5.name: Tom reacts and denies knowledge
5.description: Tom visibly freezes before claiming he knows nothing about the locked room, suggesting discomfort or concealment.

5.name: Elena signals skepticism
5.description: Elena's curt response indicates she does not believe Tom's denial.

5.name: Tom defends Marcus's privacy
5.description: Tom leans forward and warns Elena that Marcus is a private man whose solitary habits are his own business.
evidence:
TOM
(leaning forward)
Ms. Voss. Marcus is a private man. Twenty years alone out there -- people form habits. That's his business.

5.name: Elena ends the interview
5.description: Elena stands, offers her hand, and formally thanks Deputy Briggs, closing the exchange.
evidence: Elena stands and extends a hand.
